messages.author: b632c91781469fc7
messages.subject: gemBS output for methyKit
parts:
Hi,

I was just wondering if anyone is familiar with using gemBS output files for MethylKit such as the ones below

*_3_lane_gembs_cpg.bed.gz

*_3_lane_gembs_cpg.txt.gz

With the following columns

  1. Contig 
  2. Pos0 
  3. Pos1 
  4. Ref 
  5. Call 
  6. Flags 
  7. Meth 
  8. non_conv 
  9. conv 
  10. support_call 
  11. total

I tried running methylKit but it seems to run into issues with the following error

Error in data[, 5] * data[, 6] : non-numeric argument to binary operator

This happens right after I use the following code in R


file.list = list( file.path("~/methylkit", "PX0681_GCACTT_3_lane_gembs_cpg.txt"),

                  file.path("~/methylkit", "PX0681_GGCTAC_3_lane_gembs_cpg.txt"),

                  file.path("~/methylkit", "PX0681_TATAAT_3_lane_gembs_cpg.txt") )

myobj = methRead(file.list,

                 sample.id=list("CB","CMP","GMP"),

                 assembly="hg38",

                 treatment=c(0,1,1),

                 context="CpG",

                 mincov = 10

)


Any insight would be highly appreciated given my relatively limited background in Bioinformatics. 

Thank You!

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: gemBS output for methyKit
parts:
Hi,

Please have a closer look at the description of the methRead function, especially check the details section on how to use the pipeline argument. 
The examples section actually shows you how to read generic file formats. 

Best, 
Alex
